'''''Polan'' GX-8''',<ref name="Teach / Corrupt" /> or '''''Polan-GX-Eight''''',<ref name="Crystal Crown">''[[The Acolyte: The Crystal Crown]]''</ref> was the designation of<ref name="Teach / Corrupt" /> a [[Polan-717 Jedi transport]]<ref name="Databank Polan" /> utilized by the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. It was used by [[Jedi Master]]s [[Indara]], [[Sol]], and [[Kelnacca]], as well as the [[Padawan]] [[Torbin]], during their [[Mission to Brendok|mission]] to the [[planet]] [[Brendok]]. The [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es on the world, led by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]], monitored its location. Later, Aniseya's [[Aniseya family|daughters]], [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho]] and [[Verosha Aniseya]], were tested for potential [[Jedi training]] suitability while on the [[starship]] by Indara and Sol, who were using a [[Jedi testing screen]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}}</ref> Later, Jedi Master Sol and a team of [[Jedi]] utilized the [[starship]] while hunting for Mae-ho.<ref name="Lost / Found" />
